problem: Which of the following parametric equations, defined for $\theta \in [0,2\pi ),$ generate a circle of radius $15$ centered at the origin?
worked_solution:
The parametric equations of a circle  of radius $r$  centered at  the origin are

$$
x=r\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,\,y=r\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ,\,\theta \in [0,2\pi ).
$$

In our case, the radius $r=15.$ Therefore, the parametric equations of the circle are 

$$
x=15\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,\,y=15\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ,\,\theta \in [0,2\pi ).
$$
